narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a business leader's visit to Formosa Television (FTV). It uses a humorous and self-deprecating tone to show her 'acting' in a Taiwanese drama setting before transitioning to a professional talk show appearance, effectively humanizing her personal brand while providing behind-the-scenes content.
